organization.name: GRi Simulations
organization.description: GRi Simulations is a Mount Pearl engineering and software company developing high-fidelity marine simulation, virtual ROV pilot training, mission-planning, rehearsal and digital-twin tools for subsea, defence and industrial operations.

profileData.portfolioScope: VROV pilot and launch-and-recovery simulation, marine and mining digital twins, IDEA-FDK subsea planning and HarbourSync marine operations software.
profileData.publicContact: 1062 Topsail Road, Mount Pearl, NL A1N 5E6; +1 709-747-5599; support and inquiry portal at grisim.com.
profileData.currentActivity: A July 2026 ACOA announcement provides GRi Simulations $250,000 to develop products and expand sales in Canada, Europe and Southeast Asia.
profileData.evidenceBoundary: Identity, capability, location, contact and current activity are source-backed. Mission matches are derived analyst assessments and do not imply procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest or classified demand.

capabilities.name: VROV Training and Mission-Rehearsal Simulation
capabilities.summary: Train and assess ROV pilots and rehearse launch, recovery, search and intervention missions using high-fidelity vehicle, sonar, manipulator, tether, vessel and environmental simulation.
capabilities.capabilityType: ROV pilot training and mission-rehearsal simulation

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: GRi Simulations's ROV, underwater-sensing, inspection or mission-support capability could improve rapid collection and interpretation of public-source subsea observations.
